name: Parry
description: When a fighter armed with this weapon is the target of a melee attack action, increase its Defense characteristic by 1.
short: Is this fighter the target of a melee attack? Add 1 to its Defense.

name: Mighty 1
description: When a fighter makes an attack action with this weapon, increase their Fight characteristic by 1 if it is a melee weapon, or their Shoot characteristic by 1 if it is a ranged weapon.
short: Add 1 to the wielder's Fight. For a ranged weapon, add 1 to Shoot.

name: Mighty 2
description: When a fighter makes an attack action with this weapon, increase their Fight characteristic by 2 if it is a melee weapon, or their Shoot characteristic by 2 if it is a ranged weapon.
short: Add 2 to the wielder's Fight. For a ranged weapon, add 2 to Shoot.

name: Two Handed
description: This weapon counts as two hand weapons for the sake of equipment restrictions.

name: Whipcrack
description: When making melee attack actions with this weapon, the target cannot make reactions.
short: On a melee attack with this weapon, the target cannot react.

name: Unreliable
description: When making an attack action with this weapon, if any hit rolls result in a 1, all hit rolls are discarded and the attack action ends.
short: Is any hit roll a 1? Discard all hit rolls. The attack action ends.

name: Reload
description: This weapon must be reloaded after being used for an attack action. A fighter can reload one of their weapons with this special rule when making the wait action.
short: This weapon must be reloaded after an attack. Reload it with a Wait action.

name: Brace
description: When determining how many ranged weapons a fighter is equipped with, two weapons with this special rule count as one.

name: Blessed
description: Increase the Fight characteristic of the wielder by 1 when making attack actions against fighters with the `VAMPIRE`, `DAEMON` or `THRALL` keyword.
short: Add 1 to the wielder's Fight against `VAMPIRE`, `DAEMON` and `THRALL`.

name: Blast
description: When making a hit roll with this weapon, for each roll of 6, allocate 2 damage points to another visible fighter within 1” of the target of the attack action.
short: For each hit roll of 6, deal 2 damage to another visible fighter within 1" of the target.

name: One-use
description: This weapon can only be used for one attack action each battle.
short: This weapon can be used for one attack action per battle.
